profile_text.body:
Micron Technology is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000723125. It describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions.

On its own site, the company ties its memory and storage work directly to AI, saying mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive, insightful and new experiences for end users. The site also points to design tools and resources for testing, building and maintaining high-performance solutions, downloadable data sheets and technical documentation, a Technology Enablement Program (TEP), and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples.

The company's recorded legal exposure is concentrated in Idaho, with 21 entries. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or individual products are listed in the material reviewed.
